mapper.select: SELECT * FROM todo WHERE shared_with LIKE '%' || #{userId} || '%' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo (id, title, description, completed, tags, priority, is_favorite, is_archived, is_deleted, deleted_at, due_date, reminder, notification_channels, schedule_repeat, schedule_end_date, schedule_days, owner_id, shared_with, last_completed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{description}, #{completed}, #{tags, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.StringListTypeHandler}, #{priority}, #{favorite}, #{archived}, #{deleted}, #{deletedAt, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, #{dueDate, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, #{reminder, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, #{notificationChannels, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{schedule.repeat, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{schedule.endDate, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, #{schedule.daysOfWeek, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.IntegerListTypeHandler}, #{ownerId}, #{sharedWith}, #{lastCompletedAt, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE todo SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, completed = #{completed}, tags = #{tags, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.StringListTypeHandler}, priority = #{priority}, is_favorite = #{favorite}, due_date = #{dueDate, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, reminder = #{reminder, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, notified_at = #{notifiedAt, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, notification_channels = #{notificationChannels, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, schedule_repeat = #{schedule.repeat, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, schedule_end_date = #{schedule.endDate, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, schedule_days = #{schedule.daysOfWeek, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.IntegerListTypeHandler}, last_completed_at = #{lastCompletedAt, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE todo SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = #{deletedAt, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, updated_at = #{deletedAt, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE todo SET is_archived = 1, updated_at = datetime('now','localtime') WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM todo WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (owner_id = #{ownerId} OR shared_with LIKE '%' || #{ownerId} || '%') AND (title LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR description LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%') AND tags LIKE '%' || #{tags} || '%' AND priority = #{priority} ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT * FROM todo WHERE reminder IS NOT NULL AND reminder <= #{now, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler} AND (notified_at IS NULL OR notified_at < reminder) AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_archived = 0 AND completed = 0 ORDER BY reminder ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE todo SET notified_at = #{notifiedAt, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, updated_at = #{notifiedAt, typeHandler=xyz.crearts.note.keeper.mapper.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM todo WHERE schedule_repeat IN ('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'weekdays', 'custom') AND reminder IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_archived = 0 AND owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY reminder ASC
